about_the_game:
Echoes of Pinebridge is a slice-of-life visual novel that gradually develops into a supernatural mystery thriller.

Kent Matsuoka, a senior nearing graduation, just wants to enjoy his remaining days before facing an uncertain future. But his quiet life is shaken the morning Olivia—a quirky transfer student—shows up at his door.

Their first conversation is cut short when Kent suddenly collapses, his mind flooded with indecipherable noise. Though he wakes up seemingly unscathed, he can’t shake the feeling that something is off…

Your choices will guide Kent down diverging paths, each revealing fragments of the truth. Only after piecing these clues together will the forgotten history of Pinebridge College be uncovered.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains some mild adult themes such as alcohol use, violence, and sexual innuendo.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.10+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
